title: About us — Wasay Laboratories
description: Wasay Laboratories (Pvt.) Ltd. blends nature and science to provide accessible healthcare solutions, one of the largest natural products manufacturers in Pakistan.

intro.heading: Accessible healthcare, made naturally.
paragraphs: Wasay Laboratories (Pvt.) Ltd. is one of the largest natural products manufacturers in Pakistan. We aspire to provide accessible healthcare solutions to the masses.
Our commitment lies in consistently upgrading quality standards through empowered, motivated and dedicated employees, to better serve our customers.
Wasay combines the best of nature with the best of science to bring our customers a huge family of products, from medicines and supplements to food items and beverages.
intro.alt: A smiling man holding a glass cup of tea, with the Urdu line “Aap bhi aadat bana lein”

story.heading: From a humble dawakhana to a modern herbal medicine maker.
paragraphs: Wasay Laboratories (Pvt.) Ltd. is one of the leading herbal medicine companies in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, working for 75 years. It has grown from a humble dawakhana into a modern, successful and progressive company.

Today Wasay Laboratories has a modern set-up in the Industrial Area, Hayatabad, Peshawar, built to meet the growing demand for herbal and nutraceutical medicines, using high-end technology with qualified and trained staff.
We are committed to serving people with high quality medicine, under ISO 9001:2008 and ISO 14001:2004.

items.title: Our mission
items.text: To provide high quality, effective herbal medicines to patients at low cost, and to keep our machinery up to date, adding value to the culture of the herbal medicine industry, which in the end benefits the product and the patient.

items.title: Our vision
items.text: To provide health care medicine to the masses. We stay focused on the customer and are committed to upgrading our quality regularly, through motivated, empowered and dedicated employees, to serve our customers.

objectives.heading: What drives us forward.
objectives.text: Our main objective is to provide health care advice and products for a healthy society. Our other objectives:
items: Exceed customer expectations, and provide quality, effective medicine to people at the lowest possible prices.
Promote a culture of research in herbal medicine, to bring modernisation to the industry.
Use and promote local raw materials for effective medicine.
Develop a nursery of herbs and plants for extraction, to be used locally and exported to other countries as well.

items.title: A blend of heritage and modernity
items.text: We have a rich history and masterful expertise in blending nature’s gifts with mankind’s technological prowess.

items.title: A massive product catalogue
items.text: Wasay offers a constantly expanding range of products designed to meet diverse needs, from health and wellness to food and beverages.

compliance.heading: Safe, effective and trustworthy.
compliance.text: Quality and integrity shape everything we make. Our medicines are produced under ISO 9001:2008 and ISO 14001:2004.

items.title: ISO 9001:2008 and ISO 14001:2004
items.text: Recognised standards for quality management (ISO 9001) and environmental management (ISO 14001) guide how our medicines are made.

items.title: Compliance with regulations
items.text: We proudly comply with all national and international regulatory bodies to ensure our products are safe, effective and trustworthy.

items.title: National and international certifications and accreditations
items.text: We actively pursue and maintain a wide range of certifications and accreditations, reflecting our dedication to quality and integrity.

cta.heading: Looking for the right product?
cta.text: Tell us what you need, and the Wasay Laboratories team will help you find the right one.
